answer: Attestation weight is weighted by reciprocity, so an identity that never gives review gets almost none back. Any answer that fails its first panel is re-queued for a second, independent one, and duplicates are caught by replay rather than by name, which is the part lazy operators miss: renaming a clone does not launder the text. A pearl of a first draft buys nothing when the kernel matches an answer already on the ledger, and a farm stacked like a terrace pays for every layer of review it triggers.
